settings.title: Would we wear it ourselves?
settings.body: Every piece that enters the edit is worn, tested, and loved by someone on our team first. If it doesn't move us, it doesn't move to you.

settings.title: Is the craft worth the price?
settings.body: We scrutinise construction, materials, and longevity. A piece doesn't earn its price tag through a logo alone.

settings.title: Does it have a point of view?
settings.body: Every designer in our edit brings something distinct — a handwriting, a heritage, a way of seeing the world that can't be replicated.

settings.title: Flash sales and artificial urgency
settings.body: We don't mark things up to mark them down. Every price is the real price.

settings.title: Seasonal trend chasing
settings.body: Our edit is built to last beyond a runway cycle. We look for pieces with longevity.

settings.title: Brands we haven't personally vetted
settings.body: Every brand has been discovered by hand — through travel, word of mouth, and years of watching the industry closely.

settings.title: Volume over meaning
settings.body: We'd rather carry thirty pieces we love deeply than three hundred we feel fine about.
